Consulting Engineers · 55 Commerce Drive, Example, NJ 07000

August 29, 2024

Township of Example Planning Board
100 Municipal Drive
Example, NJ 07000

RE: Preliminary and Final Major Site Plan
    Maple Street Holdings, LLC
    Application No. PB-24-07
    Block 412, Lot 3.01 – 118 Maple Street
    C-2 Zone
    Engineering Review No. 1

Dear Board Members:

We have reviewed the above referenced application consisting of site plans prepared by Kowalski Engineering Associates, Inc., dated July 15, 2024 (12 sheets), a Stormwater Management Report dated July 15, 2024, and the completed application checklist.

COMPLETENESS

The applicant has requested waivers from the following checklist items:
1. Item 14 – Environmental Impact Statement. The site is fully developed and previously disturbed. We have no objection to the Board granting this waiver.
2. Item 22 – Traffic Impact Study. The proposed use generates more than 100 peak hour trips. We do not recommend that this waiver be granted; a traffic impact study must be submitted.
3. Item 31 – Aerial photograph at 1"=200'. We recommend the waiver be granted as the key map provides adequate context.

Subject to the Board's determination on the above waivers, we recommend the application be deemed complete.

STORMWATER MANAGEMENT

4. The drainage calculations shall be revised to demonstrate compliance with N.J.A.C. 7:8 as amended in 2023, including the use of NOAA Atlas 14 rainfall data with the required climate adjustment factors.
5. A stormwater maintenance plan and operations manual shall be provided for the proposed subsurface infiltration basin in accordance with N.J.A.C. 7:8-5.8.
6. Soil permeability testing shall be performed at the location of the proposed infiltration basin and the results submitted for review.
7. The plan should show the proposed inlet and pipe sizing calculations; the 15-inch outlet pipe appears undersized for the 100-year storm.

GRADING AND UTILITIES

8. Spot elevations shall be provided at all building corners, curb returns and high/low points in the parking area.
9. The applicant shall provide a will-serve letter from the Township Municipal Utilities Authority for the sanitary sewer connection. Treatment Works Approval from NJDEP may be required.
10. The retaining wall along the easterly property line exceeds four feet in height; design calculations signed and sealed by a licensed engineer shall be provided.

PARKING AND CIRCULATION

11. Twenty-four (24) parking spaces are proposed where 27 are required under Section 190-45; a variance or design waiver is required. The applicant should provide testimony regarding the parking demand.
12. Two accessible parking spaces are required under the ADA and the Barrier Free Subcode; the plan shows one. The accessible route to the building entrance shall be shown.
13. Make-ready parking spaces for electric vehicle supply equipment shall be provided in accordance with P.L. 2021, c.171.
14. Truck turning templates for the delivery vehicle (SU-30) shall be provided to demonstrate access to the loading area.

LANDSCAPING AND LIGHTING

15. Street trees shall be provided along the Maple Street frontage at 40 feet on center per Section 190-52.
16. The photometric plan indicates 0.8 foot-candles at the residential property line; the ordinance limits spillover to 0.5 foot-candles. Fixtures shall be full cutoff.
17. A trash enclosure detail shall be provided, including gates and screening.

OUTSIDE AGENCY APPROVALS

18. Approval of the Somerset-Union Soil Conservation District is required.
19. Approval of the County Planning Board is required as the site fronts on a county road.

GENERAL

20. The zoning table on Sheet 2 shall be revised to list the proposed lot coverage and all required variances.
21. All plans shall be signed and sealed by the engineer of record.

Should you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact this office.

Very truly yours,
ALBRIGHT & KELLER ENGINEERING, LLC

Thomas J. Albright, P.E., C.M.E.
Board Engineer
